venue.name: Kwakiutl Art of The Copper Maker Gallery
venue.description: This is a Kwakwaka'wakw art gallery and carving studio at Fort Rupert, near Port Hardy, run by the carver Calvin Hunt. Its website could not be read on this run. Every page of calvinhunt.com answers an automated request with a robot check and then refuses the request altogether, so nothing the gallery says about itself could be confirmed. Nothing below has been taken from the site, and nothing has been taken from tourism listings, so this entry is a placeholder until someone can open the site in a browser.

gaps: RETRIEVAL NOTE: calvinhunt.com is behind a robot check. Every request returns a page titled "Bot Verification" carrying an invisible reCAPTCHA and no site content, and after a few requests in a row the server answers 403 Forbidden instead until it cools off, whereupon the robot check comes back. Two different clients and a desktop browser user agent made no difference across half an hour. The pages do exist, they just never send their content. No browser was available on this run and a robot check must not be answered by a script, so not one page of the site was read. A fetch-only re-run will hit the same wall. This venue needs to be re-run by a person with a browser, and it should not be mistaken for a venue with nothing to offer.
nothing on this record comes from the venue's own site: the name, the city and the website address come from our own catalogue list, and the category is inferred from the venue's name alone
no address could be read from the site, so lat and lng are left null rather than pinned from a tourism listing or from general knowledge of Fort Rupert
whether the gallery hosts school or daycare groups is unknown. The site was unreadable, so this is not a statement that it does not, and both flags are left blank rather than set to false
no programs are recorded, because no page describing a visit, a carving demonstration, a studio tour or a group rate could be read. This is an unread site, not an empty one
no price of any kind could be read, for adults, children or groups
no youngest age, capacity, visit length or lead time could be read
no phone number, email address or booking route could be read from the site
no opening hours could be read
washrooms, indoor lunch space, rain shelter, parking, bus access and wheelchair or stroller access are all unknown
no images could be collected, so this venue has no hero photo and will fall back to an initials tile in the catalogue
